name: The Wreck Graveyard
riddle: Three ships lie still; the one with no name holds the flame.

steps.objective: Read the names on the wrecks' sterns.
The one with no name holds the flame.
Take what the flame shows you.

hints: Every ship carries her name on her stern. Swim round and read them all.
One stern has had its name scratched away. Look above it: what hangs there?
An old lantern can still burn: grip it and pull the trigger to strike its flint, or bring a Light Orb close.

reward.nextRiddle: Wake not the keeper, feed it instead; give it the pearl from the oyster bed.
reward.message: Map piece V! The map is whole. The trench runs on, down into the dark... and up toward a golden light.
